text:
ryan_ops: :rotating_light: pager triggered — GPU inference pool (us-west-2) queue growth + requests throttled. Autoscaler HPA not increasing replicas. Observed spike ~13:04 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2006504321 - gpu-pool-autoscale-delay. Paging #oncall. Severity: P1 (customer-facing throttling).

ryan_ops: quick snapshot:
- queue length on redis-job-queue: 12k 
- avg token-latency increased from 60ms -> 220ms
- 5xx rate for hosted-generation endpoint up from 0.3% -> 4.8%

ken_ml: I see HPA for gpu-deployment stuck at 8 replicas (min 8, max 64). kubectl get hpa: 
```
NAME         REFERENCE                TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
gpu-hpa      Deployment/gpu-deployment   0%/50%    8         64        8          3h
```
No CPU/memory pressure reported. HPA uses custom metric from prometheus-adapter.

jess_prod: customer-impact: several small PLG customers saw increased 429s and timeouts. Support queue has 18 reports flagged with priority. Not wide enterprise yet but needs containment.

aisha_sd: tagging myself oncall. I'll take primary coordination. @ryan_ops keep logs coming. @ken_ml can you pull prometheus-adapter logs and metrics-server events?

prometheus-bot: Alert: prometheus-adapter / metrics API scrape lag detected — adapter_response_time_seconds 35s (threshold 5s)

ken_ml: logs from prometheus-adapter (tail):
```
W 13:02:44 Failed to fetch metrics from Prometheus: context deadline exceeded
E 13:03:10 Error converting metric: empty result set
E 13:03:22 adapter: failed to serve metrics: grpc: the connection is unavailable
```
Also seeing Prometheus scrape backlog: remote_write queue length spiked, several scrape targets delayed.

sre-oncall: kube-metrics-server status shows repeated errors: 
```
E0313 13:01:58 aggregator.go:123] failed to get metrics from source kubelet: Get "https://10.0.1.5:10250/metrics/resource": context deadline exceeded
```
Might be network saturation or control-plane scheduling.

aisha_sd: initial mitigation plan:
1) manually scale gpu-deployment replicas to 32 to soak current queue (ken please run if acceptable)
2) restart prometheus-adapter to clear adapter backlog
3) if adapter restarts ok, watch HPA metrics for catch-up; if not, fallback to scheduled scaling policy for next 30m
4) communicate customer impact and ETA to support

ryan_ops: manual scale in progress (kubectl scale --replicas=32 deployment/gpu-deployment) — starting at 13:08 UTC. Noting pod startup takes ~45-60s on warm images.

prometheus-bot: Info: prometheus target scrape latency high, 95th percentile 22s across targets.

ken_ml: restarting prometheus-adapter now (kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter) — 13:10 UTC. Will monitor logs.

ryan_ops: new pods coming up, immediate queue processing rate increased ~3x at 13:11 UTC. CPU on new nodes normal. 5xx rate dropping to 1.6%.

jess_prod: notified support and posted customer status update: "We are mitigating a capacity issue affecting some generation requests in US-West. Engineers have started scaling and expect customer impact to reduce within 20 minutes." :email:

ken_ml: prometheus-adapter logs after restart: 
```
I 13:12:05 Adapter started
I 13:12:07 Connecting to Prometheus at http://prometheus-us-west:9090
I 13:12:14 Adapter: metrics query latency back to baseline
```
HPA custom metrics now reporting; controller triggered scale decisions.

aisha_sd: Handoff note for next oncall in 30m: monitor HPA for 30m, keep manual replica count >= 16 until adapter proven stable, and avoid scale-to-zero.

sre-oncall: verifying control-plane health — kubelet network errors reduced after we cleared a noisy node (node-az3-gpu-12 had kubelet restarts). Node cordon & drain performed 13:15 UTC.

ryan_ops: queue now down to 900 items, ingestion rate steady. 5xx down to baseline 0.4%. Latency trending down.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigating. Updated responders: aisha_sd (lead), ken_ml (metrics), ryan_ops (runtime), jess_prod (customer comms).

aisha_sd: quick postmortem actions (short):
- ENG-RUNTIME: investigate why prometheus remote_write/backlog spiked (ticket RT-2007)
- ENG-ML: add HPA fallback to scheduled scaling policy when adapter lags (ticket ML-1982)
- SRE: improve alerting to correlate prometheus-adapter latency with HPA stalls (ticket SRE-3333)
- DEVEX/Docs: update runbook for manual scale when adapter unavailable (PR incoming)

jess_prod: support update sent to affected customers with ETA and actions taken. Will follow up if enterprise customers escalate.

ken_ml: note: we should consider redundant metric source for HPA (prom-adapter + metrics-server hybrid) — reduces single point of failure. I'll draft a proposal.

aisha_sd: marking incident as resolved at 13:22 UTC - gpu capacity restored, HPA responding again, customer impact largely mitigated. Keeping incident open for postmortem and follow-ups.

ryan_ops: adding monitoring queries to track: prometheus_adapter_query_duration_seconds, hpa_controller_syncs, kubelet_request_latency.

sre-oncall: transferring pager to next oncall (ryan_ops -> luis_oncall) at 13:30 UTC. Handoff included current replica target 16 and tickets assigned.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2006504321 status -> resolved (mitigated). Postmortem owner: aisha_sd.

jess_prod: thanks team. Filing customer impact summary for postmortem.

ken_ml: follow-ups will be tracked in tickets. I'll add details about adapter root causes once we dig in.

aisha_sd: closing active coordination. Keeping thread for notes. :white_check_mark:
